name: gtm.cold_buyer
description: Cold outbound contact fit for RIG's $3,500 One-Workflow Review. Input is ONE prospect row: name, title, firm, headcount, industry, email source, and any observed workflow pain. Routes by buyer fit, not by volume.

fit.instructions: Buyer fit of this row for RIG's $3,500 One-Workflow Review -- a scoped diagnostic of one operational workflow for one accountable owner
criteria: Excluded row: a vendor selling to RIG, a competitor, a recruiter, or a job seeker. Never a buyer.
Solo freelancer, micro shop, or enterprise-scale firm: outside the 11-200 staff band this offer is priced for.
Right-size firm, but the contact neither owns nor runs operations and no workflow pain is named.
Right-size firm and the contact owns or runs operations, but no specific workflow pain is named.
Professional-services firm of roughly 11-200 staff, the contact owns or runs operations, and a specific manual or duplicated workflow is named.

seniority.instructions: The contact owns or runs operations at their firm -- owner, partner, managing partner, COO, operations or practice manager, director, or founder -- rather than an individual contributor, an intern, a student, or a purely technical staff role with no budget authority.

firm_band.instructions: Which size and type band does this firm fall in for the One-Workflow Review offer

criteria.right_size_professional_services: Professional services -- accounting, law, consulting, agency, engineering, clinic administration, or similar -- of roughly 11-200 staff
criteria.micro_or_solo: Solo freelancer, hobbyist, or a micro shop too small to own a workflow worth $3,500
criteria.enterprise: Large enterprise, government, or a business unit inside a big company -- outside the 11-200 band
criteria.vendor_or_competitor: A vendor, agency, recruiter, or competitor selling to RIG rather than buying from it

workflow_pain.instructions: The row names a specific operational workflow that is manual, duplicated, or error-prone -- onboarding, document handling, reporting, intake, scheduling, billing handoffs, or similar -- rather than a general interest in AI.

reachable.instructions: The row includes a verified work email address for this specific person: not a generic info@ or support@ address, not a guessed pattern, and not a LinkedIn-only contact.

excluded.instructions: This row is one RIG must not cold-outreach at all: a vendor pitching RIG, a competitor, an enterprise account, a recruiter, or a job seeker.

rules.reason: excluded row -- vendor, competitor, enterprise, recruiter, or job seeker must never receive cold outbound
vendor or competitor, not a buyer for the One-Workflow Review
enterprise is outside the 11-200 staff band this $3,500 offer is priced for
solo freelancer or micro shop is outside the 11-200 staff band
fit score is below the floor for cold outbound -- do not spend a send on this row
contact does not own or run operations -- find the accountable owner before sending
no named workflow pain -- the $3,500 review sells one workflow, not 'AI'
no verified email for this person -- enrich before any send

notes.purpose: Ranking number is fit.score (0..4). Code ranks by it; the rules only stop rows that must not be sent to.
notes.thresholds: Provisional and uncalibrated. Required-positive noul signals use the house bar (must read above 0.90); hazard signals split at 0.50-0.60. Law 3: this pack is advisory, so a BLOCK rule reports ESCALATE with a downgraded-BLOCK reason until s1gate calibrate certifies it.
